sql: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='3s'; SELECT json_build_object('traversals',(SELECT count(*) FROM routelens_p05.traversals),'publications',(SELECT count(*) FROM routelens_p07.publications),'consumers',(SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT consumer_id, high_water, last_snapshot_id, octet_length(artifact) AS artifact_bytes FROM routelens_p07.consumer_states ORDER BY consumer_id) x)); COMMIT;
